items.title: Afghanistan Premier League: Shakib, Nahid, Shamim get teams
items.summary: Three Bangladeshi cricketers -- Shakib Al Hasan, Nahid Rana and Shamim Hossain -- were picked by different franchises on Tuesday in the Afghanistan Premier League T20 (APL) players’ draft, which was held in Dubai.

items.title: Bangladesh name strong preliminary squad for Asia Cup Rising Stars
items.summary: Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Tuesday announced a 19-member preliminary squad for the ACC Men’s Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026, scheduled to take place in Qatar from November 19 to November 29.

items.title: ‘Till now it’s a grassy wicket’: Amite ahead of Sylhet Test
items.summary: The Sylhet surface, just like the one in Dhaka a few days ago, looked green. Windies skipper Roston Chase had said previously that grass was cut just ahead of the Mirpur Test. Amite certainly did not want to read too much into it, even as he regularly features in domestic matches and plays for Sylhet in the National Cricket League (NCL).

items.title: No Marufa as Bangladesh announce squad for Emerging Nations Trophy
items.summary: Marufa is reportedly suffering from a bone-related issue in her right foot, which also forced her to miss the third and final ODI during Bangladesh’s recent tour of Australia.
